prompt:
Create a modular dark-fantasy game UI component atlas, a REPLACEMENT PARTS SHEET for the existing illustrated card prototype. Style matches reference 1: finely hand-painted worn brass, carved charcoal slate, warm oak crate boards, quiet black enamel, Baldur's Gate 2 / Diablo 2 material craftsmanship. Reference 1 is style only; do not reproduce portrait people, old medallion, or disconnected plates.
A large square transparent PNG, 3 columns by 3 rows, NINE independent components separated by generous transparent gutters. No text, numbers, lettering, UI labels, grid, scenery, or background. All components straight front view. Real transparent exterior, opaque dark interiors.
ROW ONE:
1) ONE unified worker multiplier housing. Tall slender charcoal stem flares seamlessly at the bottom into a wide rectangular blank number plaque. The brass outer contour and engraved ribs FLOW from the stem into the plaque, a single continuous cast object, no seam or top border dividing plaque from stem. Width-to-height approximately 1:2.6. Rounded top, straight parallel narrow shaft at 52% of total width, wide base at 100%. Entire shaft interior blank smooth dark charcoal with room for a vertical stack of 4 small pawn icons. Lower 24% of overall height is an empty wide dark numeral area. No people printed in housing. Subtle engraved downward channels guide the eye from shaft to the blank multiplier base.
2) An occupied worker token: a single unidentifiable GENERIC BOARD-GAME PAWN, rounded featureless spherical head, tapered shoulders/body and simple short plinth, ivory pewter polished highlights, dark edge contour, very legible silhouette. No face, no eyes, no clothing, no hair, no hat, no tools, no gender or profession. This same exact pawn will be repeated for all workers. Transparent outside pawn.
3) The exact same pawn silhouette as component 2, but EMPTY SLOT version: recessed dark gunmetal silhouette with a restrained silver outline, much darker than occupied pawn, no facial detail, no separate border or tile.
ROW TWO: three versions of ONE physically fused Charge mechanism. Each entire object is a low wide reservoir with dark flat inset rectangular meter area spanning the bottom half, brass edge and small ornamented ends. Above it are circular recessed charcoal-black trigger wells. Each circle joins the reservoir through an integral tapering cast brass neck with subtle engraved turquoise flow channels. The lower arcs, necks and top reservoir edge are forged together into a SINGLE sculptural object, NOT circles placed near a rectangle, NOT a boxy separate trigger tray, no seam. No icon inside circles. No filled progress, no divisions, leave meter interior flat opaque near black to overlay lit segments later. Same overall width, reservoir position and height in all three versions, overall ratio approximately 2.1:1.
4) ONE trigger circle connected into reservoir, situated above left portion of reservoir. Remaining top right area is transparent.
5) TWO identical trigger circles side by side feeding reservoir, left aligned. Rest above bar transparent.
6) THREE identical trigger circles side by side feeding reservoir, evenly distributed across width. Circles should be large, smooth nearly black insides with thin crisp brass rim. Their collective width almost fills reservoir width.
ROW THREE:
7) A blank wide rectangular STOCK OUTPUT PLAQUE, width:height 1.6:1. It is visibly the front of the SAME oak and brass crate seen in reference 1: dark walnut recessed smooth center for a number, warm wooden side boards and horizontal boards, broad riveted brass corner straps. Slim illustrated wood-and-metal edging, no circular ornament. Same material and construction family as the reference crate. No perspective angle; front facing.
8) A bold amber-orange AUTUMN LEAF icon, single broad maple/oak leaf with short stem, readable bright golden-orange face and edge highlights, not a dark shrub or branch. Transparent silhouette.
9) A bold fresh green SPRING LEAF icon, single broad leaf with short stem, readable light green face and ivory-green edge highlights, matching painted style of autumn leaf and existing resource icons. Transparent silhouette.
Keep each complete component isolated inside its own cell. Full usable asset silhouettes, no numbers baked into images. Do not add extra components. All quiet dark wells must remain opaque, only exterior transparent.
notes: Prototype-only feedback pass. Original RGBA preserved; existing solar-wheel and moon-wheel are reused unchanged.
